title: Ed May worked with Prince Hans-Adam
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Ed May worked with Prince Hans-Adam, about unspecified at unspecified, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: He talks about working with the Royal Prince of Liechtenstein, Hans Adam.

plain: The podcast host Jesse Michels says that Ed May, a scientist tied to Stargate, a US government programme that studied psychic spying, talks about having worked with Hans-Adam, the reigning prince of Liechtenstein. Michels raises it because it would link that psychic research to a European royal.
